brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided two schools in Burqa village, northwest of Nablus, the Ma'an news agency reported. Details of the incursion, including the purpose of the raid and any resulting damage or disruptions to school operations, were not immediately clear.

The raid is part of a broader pattern of military operations in the occupied West Bank, where Israeli forces conduct regular incursions into Palestinian communities.
title: Occupation forces raid two schools in Burqa village northwest of Nablus
